notes.title: Hot Squat - Valentine's Day Update
notes.notes:
Listen, if you're like me you're going to be very lonely this Valentine's Day. Luckily, there's one thing that you'll never regret trusting, your gym membership at Flynn Fitness. With Hot Squat's new Valentine's Theme, we'll be able to feel love again, even if it's not from a real person. Playing Hot Squat is almost as good as human interaction. At least you're exercising this Valentine's Day, I just sat at home and made this update. If you have a chance to take a break, maybe someone could please talk to me...I don't know...

Love,
Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat – UNTITLED Update
notes.notes:
Sup squatters! We’re very excited to announce that we have just released our new virtual reality game, UNTITLED. It’s a physics based puzzle game that will test your mind and invigorate your sense of discovery. I’ve always said, the strongest muscle in your body is your brain, so why not make major gains there too? In celebration of the games release, we’ve done a complete makeover to Hot Squat to match the theme of our new release! So whether or not your check out our new game or not, we hope you enjoy getting huge in the new remodeled Flynn Fitness Gym! Happy squatting!

-    Added a temporary visual makeover to Hot Squat in the theme of our new game!

Check out UNTITLED here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/639770/UNTITLED/

Love, Bean Boy Games

notes.title: Hot Squat - Holiday Update
notes.notes:
It’s the holiday season, there’s no better time to stoke the fire, brew some hot tea, and cuddle up in bed with a good book right? WRONG. Your gains don’t take a holiday break, and neither should you! That’s why we’re releasing the Hot Squat Christmas Update, adding Christmas spirit and decorations to the gym. Now you can celebrate the holidays where you should be, at the gym getting huge! It’s time to deck the halls with lots of squatting, we’ll see you at the gym.

- Love, Bean Boy Games
